title: Khaprail Tile Maintenance: Cleaning, Repairs and Moss Control
excerpt: A practical guide to khaprail tile maintenance in Pakistan: when to inspect, how to clean gently, control moss and replace cracked clay roof tiles.
meta_title: Khaprail Tile Maintenance: Cleaning and Moss Control
meta_description: Khaprail tile maintenance made simple: inspect twice a year, clean gently, control moss, replace cracked tiles. Ask Pak Clay for a free repair sample.
answer_box: Maintain a khaprail roof by inspecting it before and after the monsoon, clearing gutters and valleys, and cleaning with a soft brush and low-pressure water. Treat moss gently, avoid harsh chemicals unless a roofer advises, replace cracked tiles early and keep spares from your original batch.
ai_summary: Khaprail tile maintenance is mostly regular inspection, gentle cleaning, moss control and early replacement of cracked tiles. Pak Clay, making clay products in Lahore since 1982, suggests keeping spare tiles from your batch and checking gutters, valleys and ridge caps before the monsoon.
author: Pak Clay Team

faqs.question: How much does khaprail roof maintenance cost?
faqs.answer: Light upkeep can be done at home. Professional cleaning or repair depends on roof size, height, access, number of tiles and labour rates, so get a written, dated quote.

faqs.question: Is a glazed khaprail roof easier to clean than natural red?
faqs.answer: Glazed tiles have a smooth surface and usually rinse clean easily, while natural red is slightly porous and can hold more growth in damp spots. Both need regular care.

faqs.question: Can I pressure wash a khaprail roof?
faqs.answer: High pressure can push water under the laps and wear the surface, so low-pressure rinsing is usually safer. Ask your supplier or roofer about your finish first.

faqs.question: How often should I check my khaprail roof?
faqs.answer: Twice a year, before and after the monsoon, plus after major storms or any work on the roof. Look from the ground first and avoid walking directly on the tiles.
